title: Google Cloud provider: HTML extraction profiles, live-derived fixtures, and a coverage declaration
objective: Add the third of six F008 providers. Google Cloud publishes BOTH a perpetual Always Free tier and a 90-day credit-backed Free Trial, and the central risk of this slice is conflating them. Every published fact must be pinned either to a real live table row or to a verbatim same-document prose block; nothing may be synthesized to satisfy the extractor, and no claim that a service is free may ship without verbatim official text behind it.
measured_premise: P1 MEASURED 2026-08-14 (live, HTTP 200): https://cloud.google.com/free/docs/free-cloud-features contains exactly 2 <table> elements. Table[0] has the live headers ['Google Cloud product', 'Free Tier usage limits'] and 29 body rows. Table[1] is an unrelated SKU cost-example table. The Always Free allowances are therefore genuinely table-published and need no synthesized structure.

P2 MEASURED (live, HTTP 200): https://cloud.google.com/firestore/pricing contains 5 tables; table[0] has the live headers ['Free tier', 'Quota'] with 5 body rows. No other table on the page carries that header pair, so the signature selects exactly one table.

P3 MEASURED (live, HTTP 200): https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/pricing contains 38 tables; exactly one, table[30], carries the headers ['Resource', 'Monthly free usage limits', 'Details'] with 2 body rows. table[27] is ['Resource', 'Pricing', 'Details'] and is NOT a superset of the signature, so selection is unambiguous.

P4 MEASURED (live): the free-cloud-features page states VERBATIM, in a block occurring exactly once, 'Although the Free Tier lets you use certain Google Cloud products at no charge, there are monthly usage limits that are calculated per billing account. Any usage that exceeds the Free Tier usage limits is billed at standard rates.' This is direct evidence of automatic_billing on exhaustion, which makes the Always Free tier Z1_BILLING_EXPOSURE rather than Z0. It is an UNFAVOURABLE finding and it is reported rather than omitted.

P5 MEASURED (live): the same page states VERBATIM, exactly once, 'During the sign up, you must provide a credit card or other payment method that is valid for the period of the Free Trial. ...'. requires_card=True for the Free Trial is therefore directly evidenced, not inferred.

P6 MEASURED (live): the same page states VERBATIM, exactly once, 'To use products that have a Free Tier, you need a Google Cloud billing account.' and 'A Google Cloud billing account is required to access the Google Cloud Free Tier. ...'. NEITHER states that the billing account itself requires a payment method. Composing the card sentence (which is scoped to Free Trial signup) with the billing-account sentence would be an INFERENCE, not a quotation, so requires_card is left UNKNOWN for the Always Free profile and the billing-account requirement is recorded as its own evidenced fact.

P7 MEASURED (live): every prose block this slice pins occurs EXACTLY ONCE in its live document, so no pin can produce ambiguous_assertion. Blocks measured at 3 occurrences on the free-cloud-features page (marketing strap lines such as 'No automatic charges, no commitment.') are deliberately NOT pinned.

P8 MEASURED (repository): docs/DATA_MODEL.md 'Choosing between always_free and recurring_quota' rule 1 requires the provider to identify an indefinitely available zero-priced plan/tier/SKU. The free-cloud-features page states 'The Free Tier has no end date' verbatim, satisfying rule 1. The Firestore and BigQuery pricing pages state no such thing on their own document; each identifies a replenishing free allowance on a service that is itself metered, which is rule 2. Those two profiles therefore emit recurring_quota, and the choice is recorded rather than inferred from the word 'free'.
P9 MEASURED (repository, base 73f83d2): no test asserts that production profiles never emit recurring_quota; the value is already in OFFER_TYPES and in the web vocabulary.

P10 MEASURED: https://cloud.google.com/robots.txt (HTTP 200) has a single 'User-agent: *' group whose Disallow rules cover /console, /landing/, /walkthroughs/, /terms/looker/*, /log, two /partners/resources pages, and the per-language /*/docs/reference/* trees. None of /free/docs/, /firestore/, or /bigquery/ is disallowed, so automated retrieval of the three cited pages is permitted.
services_covered_and_why: Google Cloud Free Tier (the program-level Always Free allowances) - chosen because the allowances are published in one real live table keyed by product, and because the page states the offer's perpetuity, its billing-account requirement, and its exhaustion behaviour in three separate verbatim blocks.

Google Cloud Free Trial - chosen as the deliberate NON-Z0 control. It is credit-backed and time-limited and it requires a payment method, all stated verbatim. It shares a document with the Always Free tier, which is exactly why it is extracted separately: the two offers must never be conflated.
Firestore - chosen because its pricing page publishes a small, unambiguous 'Free tier | Quota' table and states the free quota's reset cadence and its continuation condition in prose.

BigQuery - chosen because its pricing page publishes an explicit 'Monthly free usage limits' table and one verbatim sentence that simultaneously establishes the allowance survives the trial and that exceeding it is charged.

REJECTED: Cloud Run, Artifact Registry and Pub/Sub pricing pages were probed live and publish no free-tier table (only committed-use discount price tables). Covering them would have required inferring allowances from the program-level page, which is cross-document composition, so they are not covered.

acceptance_criteria: A1: every profile extracts successfully from the LIVE page, not only from the committed fixture, with the fact set and per-fact evidence count reported for each.
A2 LIVE -> FIXTURE (primary direction): every live target-table row and every pinned live block appears in the corresponding fixture. Reported as counts, with the live-primary direction called out.
A3 FIXTURE -> LIVE (supporting direction only): every fixture row and pinned block occurs in the live document. This direction may never carry a pass alone.
A4: capture.json explicitly discloses every deletion inside an extracted table (expected: none) and every non-target table removed, and states the measured live table count.
A5: no synthesized table anywhere. The Free Trial profile is mode='assertions' and declares no table selector; its fixture contains zero <table> elements and says so.

A6: Always Free and the Free Trial are separate offers with separate offer types. Nothing trial-like or credit-backed can reach Z0, verified by running the real classifier rather than by assuming the vocabulary does it.

A7: requires_card is asserted ONLY where a single verbatim block states it. It is True for the Free Trial and deliberately UNKNOWN elsewhere, with the reason recorded in the capture and the module docstring.

A8: mutation tests prove each guard - a deleted, reworded and truncated pinned sentence each yield assertion_not_found, and an undeclared matrix row yields unknown_matrix_rows. Each mutation anchor matches EXACTLY ONCE, the patched line is printed, the target error is shown UNPRODUCIBLE on an input that should raise it, a collateral check confirms a healthy document still extracts, and the source is restored byte-exactly proved by BLOB HASH.
A9: the classifier verdict is recorded for every offer added.
A10: the full test suite and scripts/check.ps1 -NodeAudit are run, and which of them ran against a real PostgreSQL is stated.
A11: the diff is limited to approved files, agent-state/feature_list.json is byte-identical to base, apps/web is zero-diff, and the pull request remains DRAFT.
verification_plan: Re-derive origin/main with git ls-remote before branching and again immediately before reporting.
State a prediction BEFORE each measurement and record where the prediction was wrong.
Drive the real HtmlDocAdapter over LIVE bytes and over the committed fixture, and compare fact sets and evidence selectors.
Judge STRUCTURE, never digest: cloud.google.com embeds per-build markup, so a live digest is not reproducible across fetches.
Run any filtered git diff UNFILTERED first as a positive control, and quote "$base..HEAD" so PowerShell does not split at the dot.
Prove fixture restoration after mutation by git hash-object against git rev-parse ref:path, never by numstat.
Open a draft PR and inspect its state with gh pr view.
negative_tests: A reworded pinned sentence must REJECT the document with assertion_not_found, not silently publish a stale value.
A truncated pinned sentence must REJECT: whole-block normalised equality means a prefix is not a match.
A deleted pinned sentence must REJECT.
An undeclared matrix row added to the target table must REJECT with unknown_matrix_rows, so a product Google adds later is never silently dropped.
A removed mapped row must REJECT with missing_matrix_rows.
A renamed tier column must REJECT with table_not_found.
A duplicated target table must REJECT with ambiguous_table.
Whitespace and entity noise inside a mapped row label must NOT reject: normalisation is intended behaviour and a false positive here would teach authors to loosen the guard.
The Free Trial offer must NOT reach Z0 under any of the three classifier paths (card known True, all conditions unknown, and a hypothetical all-known-no-card input).
data_implications: No migration and no schema change. This slice adds provider configuration data, extraction profiles, and test fixtures only. The coverage declaration writes no rows by itself; it is validated config.
security_privacy: Adds one new official documentation host (cloud.google.com) to the URL allowlist. No credentials, no new dependency, no network access from the test suite (every fixture test runs through FixtureFetcher). Live retrieval happened only during authoring and is recorded in each capture.json.
portability: Standard library only. The profiles are declarative data consumed by the existing engine; no adapter code changes.
z0_risk: Direct and high. Google Cloud is the provider most likely to produce a false $0 claim, because its Always Free tier sits inside a metered account whose overage bills automatically and whose trial is credit-backed and card-gated. This slice deliberately publishes the unfavourable facts - automatic billing on exhaustion, a required billing account, a required payment method for the trial - so that the classifier withholds Z0 for every Google Cloud offer it adds.
